whatIs.heading: What is Small Talk Maker
whatIs.content: Small Talk Maker is a web application that randomly suggests conversation topics. It provides diverse topics from various categories such as hobbies, gourmet, travel, work, technology, daily life, and more.

purpose.heading: Purpose
purpose.content: It helps facilitate smooth conversations in various situations, including conversations with new acquaintances, breaking awkward silences, team building, and icebreakers.

features.heading: Features
items: Support for 8 languages (Japanese, English, Chinese, Korean, Spanish, German, French, Portuguese)
Compatible with smartphones, tablets, and PCs

howItWorks.heading: How to Use
howItWorks.content: Simply click the 'Show Topic' button to display a randomly selected conversation topic. If you don't like the topic, you can click the button again to display a different one. You can select your preferred language from the language switcher menu in the top right corner.

languages.heading: Supported Languages
languages.list: 日本語, English, 简体中文, 한국어, Español, Deutsch, Français, Português

intro.heading: Introduction
intro.content: Small Talk Maker (the 'Service') respects user privacy and is committed to protecting personal information. This Privacy Policy explains what information the Service collects and how it is used.

dataCollection.heading: Information We Collect
dataCollection.content: The Service does not have a user account system and does not collect personally identifiable information (such as name, email address, or physical address). However, we may collect anonymous usage statistics (such as page views, language preferences, and device type) to improve the service and enhance user experience.

cookies.heading: Use of Cookies
cookies.content: The Service may use cookies and local storage to save your language preferences and improve service functionality. This data is stored in your browser and does not identify you personally. You can disable cookies in your browser settings, but some features may not function properly.

thirdParty.content: The Service uses the following third-party services for advertising and analytics purposes.

adsense.heading: Google AdSense
adsense.content: This site uses Google AdSense to serve advertisements. Google uses cookies to serve ads based on users' interests. You can opt out of personalized advertising by visiting Google's Ads Settings page (https://www.google.com/settings/ads). For more information, please refer to Google's Privacy Policy.

dataSecurity.heading: Data Security
dataSecurity.content: The Service implements reasonable technical and organizational measures to ensure the security of collected data. However, transmission of information over the Internet is not completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

childrenPrivacy.heading: Children's Privacy
childrenPrivacy.content: The Service does not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you are a parent or guardian and believe your child has provided personal information, please contact the operator.
